results: Atomic rollback and persistent replay preserve exactly one committed local command/event/reservation under tested failures and races.
A lost reply is inspected using its original key; unknown host effects remain unresolved and read/recovery never invokes a host.
Real v2 copy upgrade preserves source/backup; malformed or unknown schemas fail closed.
The earlier reported DNS/model interruption produced no implementation delta and required no route change.
limitations: Full-history replay is bounded by the existing 32-MiB store and JSON/operation limits; this is not an unbounded production service.
Hashes and local SQLite do not authenticate a coherent malicious same-privilege rewrite.
Entity assignments are fixed in this slice; later replanning requires an explicit protocol.
No scheduler, authenticated authority ingress, job-budget policy, native model delegation or full engineering loop is supplied by WP-120.
Two existing local symlink-privilege cases remain skipped.
rollback: Preserve the original store and verified migration backup. Revert code only with a new commit; inspect/reconcile outstanding operations before replay, never reset history or delete journals manually.
